Tasker page provides you to organize your task. Designed as columns consist of Known Issue, Feature, Fix. In Tasker, you can create a task setting a type from the one of the previous three types. So they are regular now. When you decide to start the work on a task created on Tasker page, you can move the task to Board page.

Board page was designed as simple Kanban Board containing Do, Doing and Done steps. You don't have to worry about creating steps and organizing them. Just focus your product.
